It was Oct 2017 that @TaranaBurke’s #MeToo resurfaced. This is a gentle reminder to journalists and media folks that survivors stories and trauma cannot be measured or held in your hands. 
And a note to survivors - I love you, you’re not alone, I’m holding you in the light ✨ https://t.co/fTsGZo3pNP

Survivorship is leadership, survivorship is a community, survivors are magic. Thank you @_char_bennett_ for highlighting that in your conversation with @JocelynNoveckAP about #MeToo. 
Survivors are centering ourselves, lifting one another up, we don't need permission from anyone. https://t.co/Thr3QwgFOm
